messages.output_raw: Need to cancel an order I just placed for a desk lamp

steps.output_raw:
<think>I must cancel an order using tools. Need order identifier details. Start plan then ask for info.</think>
<plan>
1. Ask for details to locate the correct order (order ID or email/zip/last4).
2. Once I have identifiers, look up the order using find_orders.
3. Check what parts of the order are cancelable and whether it’s a full or partial cancellation.
4. Get a refund estimate if needed, then execute the cancellation.
5. Confirm the cancellation result and refund info to the user.</plan>
<action type="say">
I can help with that.

To start the cancellation, I need to locate your order. Please provide ONE of the following:

- Order ID (preferred), or  
- Email on the order + shipping ZIP code, or  
- Email on the order + last 4 digits of the card you used

Also, is the desk lamp the only item on that order, or were there other items you want to keep?</action>
